messages:
maya: Heads up — our sampling run for low-volume tenants is undercounting token usage by ~40% in tail cases.
liam: Hmm, saw that in night runs. Which sampling config? link to run: https://ci/reports/8934
maya: It's the new sparsity sampler (p=0.02) + hourly rollup. The bug is that short sessions with very long outputs get sampled out entirely.
jordan: Can you paste a repro? example tenant/fingerprint would help.
maya: tenant=acme-demo, example request_ids: [r_20260328_01, r_20260328_17], combined tokens ~12k, both requests dropped -> billed 0.
samar: Oof. That's revenue-leaking and customer-unhappy. Is sampling keyed by request count?
liam: Current heuristic: sample by request-count-per-tenant-per-minute. So bursts with few requests but big token length have low chance to be picked.
maya: Right. Options: sample by token-count instead, hybrid (always sample if tokens > threshold), or weight by tokens.
jordan: Token-weighted sampling makes sense: heavier events get sampled more often. Cost shifts to metadata but better accuracy.
samar: Reservoir sampling deterministic per (tenant, day) with weight=tokens could give stable multipliers for billing.
liam: Quick sketch:
```
if tokens >= 2048:
  emit_raw()
else:
  reservoir.sample(key=tenant_day, weight=tokens)
```

maya: Also we need reconciler to inflate sampled events by 1/p and emit audit events for sampled set. Must be idempotent.
metering-bot: NOTE: Sampling inflation MUST be idempotent for replays. Recommendation: include sample_id + seed in provenance header.
jordan: Agree. We should also keep raw copies for any event above the token threshold (>=2k) for 30d TTL for audit. That helps investigations without blowing storage.
samar: Quick back-of-envelope: top 0.3% of events are >2k tokens but represent ~12% of tokens. Storing those raw for 30d seems affordable.
liam: We should also surface effective sampling rate per-tenant in the console and include a sampling disclosure on invoices for transparency.
maya: Implementation plan (short):
- token-weighted reservoir sampler (owner: liam)
- reconciler: inflation + idempotency (owner: jordan)
- console: sampling_policy & per-tenant rate (owner: maya)
- enterprise audit retention knob (owner: samar)

liam: I'll open a PR with the sampler config + unit tests and a sim harness. Running e2e sim for a week against prod-like traces.
jordan: Add an eval harness: simulate 1M tenants, heavy-tail token distribution, measure revenue delta and per-tenant error.
maya: Add alerting: sample-rate drift (>5% from expected) and revenue-delta anomaly alerts.
samar: Migration risk: we'll do canary with dual-write raw events for 24h to compare reconciled revenue vs current system.
liam: Canary plan noted. Dual-write toggle + compare job, then ramp.
metering-bot: Action created: MTR-4523 sampling revamp; owner=liam; due=2026-04-07
ops-bot: deploy scheduled to canary: infra-team at 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC
maya: Linking design doc: /docs/meters/sparsity-sampling-revamp.md (draft).
jordan: I'll follow up with test vectors and replay script in the PR.
maya: Thanks all. Let's track progress in the ticket and sync next Wed. :thumbsup:
